chunks: What are they waiting for? That the angels should come to them, or your Lord should come, or some of the signs of your Lord should come? The day when some of the signs of your Lord come, it will not avail a soul its faith if it did not believe before, or earn good through its faith. Say: 'Wait, we are waiting.'
ai.seo_question: What happens to faith on the Day of Judgment if it is embraced too late?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights the finality of the 'door of repentance' (bab al-tawbah), emphasizing that mere verbal declaration at the moment of death or the appearance of major signs (like the rising of the sun from the west) is insufficient without prior sincere faith and good deeds. It serves as a warning against procrastination, reinforcing the concept that the time for genuine spiritual preparation is limited to the period of life before the definitive signs manifest.
